title: Signal Garden picture
intent: Let the visual world respond to the performance while preserving room for faces, breath, and silence to remain imagined rather than illustrated.
operator: Name or role of the person or agent who rendered the picture

tool.name: Renderer, editor, DAW, or visual tool
tool.version: Exact version if known; otherwise write unknown
tool.session_format: Native project, score, timeline, or interchange format

changes.intent: Describe what the picture makes newly visible or emotionally clear in the performance.
changes.details: Describe the visual events, their timing, and any meaningful first/last-frame behavior.
changes.settings_or_unknown: Record known prompts, seeds, render settings, plug-ins, effects, and automation; write unknown where unavailable.

unknowns: List undisclosed renderer defaults, model state, plug-in state, color transforms, timing behavior, or other uncertainty.

evidence.role: editable visual score, project, prompt, or timeline
evidence.note: Explain how this source relates to the rendered picture.
evidence.rights_note: State ownership, licenses, model/source material, and any unresolved reuse boundary.

rights_note: State ownership and permission for every visual source; do not infer publication permission from possession of the render.
